<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
  <key>Label</key><string>cn.coforge.computer.daemon</string>
  <key>EnvironmentVariables</key><dict><key>COFORGE_DAEMON_CONNECTION_ENDPOINT</key><string>wss://coforge.example/connection/websocket</string></dict>
  <key>ProgramArguments</key>
  <array><string>/Users/example/.coforge/computer/install/active/coforge-computer</string><string>__daemon</string><string>--socket</string><string>/Users/example/.coforge/daemon/daemon.sock</string><string>--state-directory</string><string>/Users/example/.coforge/daemon</string></array>
  <key>StandardOutPath</key><string>/Users/example/.coforge/daemon/daemon.log</string>
  <key>StandardErrorPath</key><string>/Users/example/.coforge/daemon/daemon.log</string>
  <key>RunAtLoad</key><true/>
  <key>KeepAlive</key><true/>
  <key>ProcessType</key><string>Background</string>
</dict>
</plist>
